text:
mina.s: quick heads-up — SOC Insurance (enterprise) is asking if they can apply reserved capacity credits to burst usage. they want to guarantee low latency for peak days but don't want to overcommit. asking about per-token delta and how overages would charge.

ton y.r: do they have a current reserved contract or are they just buying credits ad-hoc?

mina.s: they signed a 6mo reserved pool last quarter (committed GPUs) and bought a small block of credits up-front. now their traffic spiked 3x for 2 days and they want the extra to come from credits rather than paying the higher on-demand per-token.

alex.p: are they expecting credits to be auto-applied to burst overage? historically credits apply to hosted usage first, but reserved capacity billing is separate. we need to clarify policy. @billing-bot any quick pointer? :thinking_face:

billing-bot: Current policy summary: credits are consumed against invoiceable usage tiers in the following order: 1) Hosted API usage, 2) Reserved committed usage shortfalls (if configured), 3) One-off billed addons. Credits do NOT automatically change per-token rates for burst capacity. Overages billed at negotiated overage rate unless explicit contract says otherwise.

kate.eng: technically we can route burst requests through reserved pool where capacity exists, but mixing billing buckets is more complicated — the billing pipeline expects a single routing tag per request. changing that means touching accounting and tagging in the runtime and the billing ETL. estimate ~2w of eng work + 1w QA if we want automatic credit application to burst.

tony.r: from support perspective customers read "credits" as a discount they can apply anywhere. we'll get a lot of tickets if we don't document this clearly.

alex.p: product question: do we treat this as a pricing/contract clarity doc (fast win) or a product change to support cross-bucket credit application (bigger)?

eva.pm: propose triage plan: 1) short-term: clarify public docs & Sales FAQ + update contract language (P0 doc work). 2) medium-term: product change to allow optional credit-routing for burst with opt-in config per-customer (P2). 3) long-term: consider UI for credits allocation per pool (P3).

mina.s: customer will take docs + manual bookkeeping for now but asked if we can propose an official workflow they can buy and enable. they prefer an opt-in toggle (billing-level) that applies credits to burst until depleted, then fall back to on-demand.

alex.p: acceptance criteria for the medium-term change (what should be in the ticket): - API for billing-routing flag per-customer - runtime routing to mark requests as "credit-eligible" - billing ETL changes to consume credits in that order - e2e test showing credits applied to burst events - updated SLA language for committed vs burst pricing

kate.eng: adding technical constraints: need a request-scoped header or token tag so router & accounting agree. sample header: ```X-RI-Billing: credit_eligible``` we'll also need migration for historical usage and a flag to opt customers in/out.

mina.s: can we do a staged rollout? customer wants to trial on a single project first.

eva.pm: yes — rollout plan: canary on single account -> monitor cost delta and error rates -> widen. Launch criteria: docs updated, billing tests green, canary success for 14 days with no regressions, and legal sign-off on contract language.

alex.p: priority recommendation: docs/contract clarification = immediate (P1 to get off the inbox), create product ticket for credit-routing feature and label P2 for roadmap. engineering estimate: 3 weeks baseline.

tony.r: i'll file a support note and template response for sales while product ticket is created.

mina.s: thanks. i'll update SOC Insurance and propose the staged opt-in flow. can someone create the product intake ticket with the acceptance criteria above and attach the billing-bot summary?

eva.pm: i'll create the ticket after standup and link this thread. tagging @alex.p for prioritization. :thumbsup:

alex.p: great. next steps: eva files ticket, kate adds technical spike to eng backlog, billing team to draft exact overage math for quotes, support to provision templated response.

mina.s: noted — will share customer spike numbers (token counts + days) in the intake ticket. thanks everyone. :pray:
